stem: Why is "jewel bird" an appropriate name for the sleeping bird Nanna and the narrator find?

options.label: F
options.text: It is graceful as it rises into the air.

options.label: G
options.text: The sun can bring it back to life.

options.label: H
options.text: It has a spot of vibrant red on its throat.

options.label: J
options.text: The golden feathers on its chest puff up.
